{{Quote|Ah, gentlebeings! Welcome to the herdship ''Veldt''. What can I interest you in today?|Tredo Dopra|<ref name="SETSB" />}}
'''Tredo Dopra''' was the chief [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Veldt (Ithorian Herdship)|''Veldt'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''Veldt'' traveled from the uncharted reaches of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], trading with other beings throughout its travels. Dopra's products aboard the ''Veldt'' included [[Shimmersilk/Legends|shimmersilk]] from<ref name="SETSB" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth's]] [[City/Legends|city]] of<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]], [[Flatsculp/Legends|flatsculps]] from [[Oordo III]], and [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca stone]] jewelry from<ref name="SETSB" /> the planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]].<ref name="SETSB" />

Tredo Dopra considered the travels the greatest joy of the trading profession, seeing exotic locations that beggared the imagination. Gathering goods from the far corners of the universe in order to pass them onto others, Dopra advertised showing beings what [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] would have to offer. A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Dopra wore a red [[Clothing/Legends|garment]] over a brown one, with both garments exposing the chest area and ending at the [[Limb/Legends|thigh]]. A [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with pouches was worn over the undergarment across the waist.<ref name="SETSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tredo Dopra was mentioned in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SETSB" />
